defects.quote: all at the moment the series is set up
defects.description: Booking every session when the series is set up books the court up to 8 weeks ahead (in the Autumn term scenario, 20 October is booked on 31 August), which the brief rules out: bookings open 14 days before the slot and nobody, admins included, can book further ahead.

defects.quote: - THEN the series is set up with its 10 sessions
defects.description: The Ten weeks scenario accepts a 10-session series, but its rule refuses any series that would have more than 8 sessions.

defects.quote: the first date until the end date
defects.description: "Until the end date" does not say whether a session falling on the end date itself is booked (inclusive or exclusive), and both scenarios end on a Friday so they do not settle it.
